title: STAT3/HIF1A and EMT specific transcription factors regulated genes: Novel predictors of breast cancer metastasis.
authors: Hegde, Mangala; Daimary, Uzini Devi; Kumar, Aviral; Chinnathambi, Arunachalam; Alharbi, Sulaiman Ali; Shakibaei, Mehdi; Kunnumakkara, Ajaikumar B
one_liner_zh: 该文基于转录组数据筛选乳腺癌转移相关基因，涉及STAT3/HIF1A及EMT转录因子调控，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属纯表达与临床关联分析。
abstract: Metastasis, the fatal hallmark of breast cancer (BC), is a serious hurdle for therapy. Current prognostic approaches are not sufficient to predict the metastasis risk for BC patients. Therefore, in the present study, we analyzed gene expression data from GSE139038 and TCGA database to develop predictive markers for BC metastasis. Initially, the data from GSE139038 which contained 65 samples consisting of 41 breast tumor tissues, 18 paired morphologically normal tissues and 6 from non-malignant breast tissues were analyzed for differentially expressed genes (DEGs). DEGs were obtained from three different comparisons: paired morphologically normal (MN) versus tumor samples (C), apparently normal (AN) versus tumor samples (C), and paired morphologically normal (MN) versus apparently normal samples (AN). Multiple bioinformatic methods were employed to evaluate metastasis, EMT and triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) specific genes. Further, regulation of gene expression, clinicopathological factors and DNA methylation patterns of DEGs in BC were validated with TCGA datasets. Our bioinformatic analysis showed that 40 genes were upregulated and 294 were found to be downregulated between AN vs C; 124 were upregulated and 760 genes were downregulated between MN vs C; 4 were upregulated and 13 were downregulated between MN vs AN. Analysis using TCGA dataset revealed 18 genes were significantly altered in nodal positive BC patients compared to nodal negative BC patients. Our study showed novel candidate genes as predictive markers for BC metastasis which can also be used for therapeutic targets for BC treatment.
abstract_zh: 转移（Metastasis）是乳腺癌（BC）的致命标志，是治疗中的严重障碍。当前的预后方法不足以预测BC患者的转移风险。因此，在本研究中，我们分析了来自GSE139038和TCGA数据库的基因表达数据，以开发BC转移的预测标志物。最初，分析了GSE139038的数据，该数据包含65个样本，包括41个乳腺肿瘤组织、18个配对形态学正常组织和6个非恶性乳腺组织，以寻找差异表达基因（DEGs）。DEGs通过三种不同比较获得：配对形态学正常（MN）与肿瘤样本（C）、表观正常（AN）与肿瘤样本（C），以及配对形态学正常（MN）与表观正常样本（AN）。采用多种生物信息学方法评估转移、上皮-间质转化（EMT）和三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）特异性基因。进一步，使用TCGA数据集验证了BC中DEGs的基因表达调控、临床病理因素和DNA甲基化模式。我们的生物信息学分析显示，在AN与C比较中，40个基因上调，294个基因下调；在MN与C比较中，124个基因上调，760个基因下调；在MN与AN比较中，4个基因上调，13个基因下调。使用TCGA数据集的分析显示，与淋巴结阴性BC患者相比，淋巴结阳性BC患者中有18个基因显著改变。我们的研究揭示了新的候选基因作为BC转移的预测标志物，这些基因也可用作BC治疗的治疗靶点。
